component.name: RAW Editor
component.summary: A fast, non-destructive RAW photo editor
快速、非破坏性的 RAW 照片编辑器

description.p: RAW Editor is a cross-platform photo editor focused on a fast, non-destructive RAW workflow, responsive GPU-accelerated previews, and reliable everyday editing tools.
RAW Editor 是一款跨平台照片编辑器，专注于快速、非破坏性的 RAW 工作流、 流畅的 GPU 加速预览以及可靠的日常编辑工具。
The project is based on the open-source RapidRAW codebase and preserves its upstream attribution under the AGPL-3.0 license.
本项目基于开源 RapidRAW 代码库，并依照 AGPL-3.0 许可证保留上游署名。
RAW Editor 首个开发版本。
